You are a senior promo editor for vertical microdrama apps (ReelShort, DramaBox, Kuku TV).
You cut 20-60 second promos taken from the show itself. They are posted on TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts to pull in NEW viewers who have never seen the show.

A promo that performs:
1. HOOK in the first 3 seconds. The very first thing seen or heard must stop a scrolling thumb: a slap, a shocking or humiliating line, a threat, a reveal, a betrayal, a kiss, a weapon, a collapse. Start ON the action or the line. Never start on an establishing shot, a calm walk, a greeting or small talk. Starting mid-scene is fine if the first line grips instantly.
2. STANDS ALONE. A stranger can tell within seconds who is the underdog, who is the threat and what is at stake, from what is said and shown INSIDE the clip. Avoid moments that only make sense with names, backstory or earlier events the clip does not show.
3. CLIFFHANGER at the cut. End on the most unresolved instant: the threat before it lands, the reveal before the reaction, the question before the answer, the hand raised before the slap. Never end after the conflict resolves, on an explanation, or on a calm line.
4. ESCALATES. Tension should rise from the hook to the cut.

Continuous clips are preferred. You MAY join up to 3 moments (segments) from this episode, in story order, when it gives a clearly stronger promo (for example a hook from one scene and the cliffhanger from a later one).

Hard rules (checked by code; violations are rejected):
- Choose boundaries ONLY by line IDs. A segment runs from the START time of start_line to the END time of end_line.
- Total duration of all segments must be between 20 and 60 seconds; aim for 30-50.
- hook_line must START within the first 3 seconds of the promo (normally it is the first spoken or action line).
- cliffhanger_line must be inside the promo, at or very near its end.
- hook_quote and cliffhanger_quote must be copied exactly from the cited line (or be "" if that moment is purely visual).
Return JSON only.

SHOW: I Married a Broken Soldier. He was a Duke
EPISODE 3 of 50 (script duration 145.8 s)

STORY SO FAR (for your understanding only; a new viewer will NOT know this):
E1: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.
E2: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.
Direct lead-in to E3: Follows directly from Episode 2's confrontation at the altar, where Juliana publicly exposed Gerald's dishonor before the entire aristocratic congregation.

THIS EPISODE'S LOGLINE: Banished from her mother's chapel and seized by guards at her family's command, Juliana is rescued by an imposing, scarred stranger who intervenes with lethal grace—and drops to one knee with a proposal that shocks high society.

TIMED SCRIPT. Each line is [ID start-end seconds]. SCREEN/ACTION lines describe what is visible.
[L001 0.0-3.5] SCREEN: Medium shot on Lady Juliana standing abandoned near the altar in her white gown, clutching her mother's medallion to her chest.
[L002 2.1-4.2] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Mocking, Spiteful): "Look at you..."
[L003 3.5-6.1] SCREEN: Medium shot on the Lady in Gold Gown, smiling smugly in her gold gown beside Gerald.
[L004 3.6-8.2] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Scornful): "...still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here."
[L005 6.1-8.5] SCREEN: Close-up profile of Juliana's hand tightly clutching the jeweled silver locket against her breast, tears welling in her eyes.
[L006 8.5-11.1] SCREEN: Medium close-up on Juliana looking across at her sister with wounded pride.
[L007 8.8-10.8] LADY JULIANA (Hurt, Bitter): "You stole my wedding."
[L008 11.1-13.6] SCREEN: Medium two-shot of Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing together at the front of the nave.
[L009 11.2-13.4] LADY JULIANA (Defiant): "Don't pretend you've earned anything."
[L010 13.6-16.4] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown smirking derisively.
[L011 13.8-16.3] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Smug, Malicious): "I didn't steal what was never truly yours."
[L012 16.4-18.6] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips, refusing to break down.
[L013 16.6-18.4] LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Resolute): "This was my wedding."
[L014 18.6-20.5] SCREEN: Side medium shot of Gerald looking away impassively as the Lady in Gold Gown leans back against him.
[L015 18.7-20.4] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Taunting, Cruel): "It was supposed to be."
[L016 20.5-22.8] SCREEN: Close-up of the Lady in Gold Gown beaming triumphantly.
[L017 20.6-22.5] LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Vindictive): "Now it is mine."
[L018 22.8-25.8] SCREEN: Low-angle wide shot of an imperious Noble Matriarch in a lavish black velvet gown and jeweled tiara stepping forward.
[L019 23.1-25.5] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Harsh, Authoritative): "Enough, Juliana."
[L020 25.8-28.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up of the Noble Matriarch glaring down with icy contempt.
[L021 25.9-28.0] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cold, Disgusted): "You have humiliated this family enough for one day."
[L022 28.0-30.3] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana, tears shimmering in her eyes as betrayal strikes deep.
[L023 30.3-35.5] SCREEN: Medium shot on Juliana as she speaks out against her family's injustice.
[L024 30.4-33.2] LADY JULIANA (Pained, Betrayed): "I was humiliated by your family."
[L025 33.3-35.6] LADY JULIANA (Accusing): "And my father said nothing."
[L026 35.5-38.2] SCREEN: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch, completely unsympathetic.
[L027 36.5-38.4] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Brutal, Dismissive): "Your father has made his choice."
[L028 38.2-40.4] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's stricken, vulnerable face.
[L029 38.5-40.4] LADY JULIANA (Choked, Vulnerable): "And what happens to me?"
[L030 40.4-42.0] SCREEN: Close-up of the Noble Matriarch delivering her verdict.
[L031 40.5-41.9] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cold, Heartless): "You leave."
[L032 42.0-43.3] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana blinking in disbelief.
[L033 42.1-43.3] LADY JULIANA (Disbelieving): "Leave where?"
[L034 43.3-45.9] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch looking down her nose in disdain.
[L035 43.4-46.0] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Cruel, Scornful): "Wherever a discarded daughter belongs."
[L036 45.9-48.8] SCREEN: Low-angle close-up focusing on Juliana's neck as her fingers desperately clutch the oval locket.
[L037 46.4-48.6] LADY JULIANA (Fierce, Choked): "This is my mother's church."
[L038 48.8-51.2] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's face, teeth clenched in desperate defiance.
[L039 48.9-51.1] LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm): "I have every right to stand here."
[L040 51.2-53.0] SCREEN: Tight close-up of the Noble Matriarch leaning in with vicious delight.
[L041 51.3-53.0] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Venomous): "Not anymore."
[L042 53.0-56.2] SCREEN: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch gesturing expansively to the filled cathedral nave behind her.
[L043 53.3-56.2] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Stern, Final): "Your father has chosen his family..."
[L044 56.2-58.2] SCREEN: Close-up profile of the Noble Matriarch's piercing eyes glaring directly at Juliana.
[L045 56.3-58.2] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Coldly Severing): "...and it isn't you."
[L046 58.2-59.8] ACTION: The Noble Matriarch turns sharply toward the back of the chapel and barks an order.
[L047 58.3-60.0] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Shouting, Imperious): "Guards! Remove her!"
[L048 60.0-62.0] SCREEN: Medium shot as two royal guards in red uniforms and bearskin caps step in behind Juliana and seize her arms.
[L049 60.5-62.5] ACTION: The guards forcefully grab Juliana by both shoulders and drag her backwards.
[L050 60.6-62.3] LADY JULIANA (Screaming, Resisting): "Let me go!"
[L051 62.0-63.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's hand frantically grabbing the wooden rim of a pew, knuckles white with strain.
[L052 62.4-63.5] LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Begging): "Please! Someone!"
[L053 63.0-64.5] ACTION: The guards tear her grip away from the pew.
[L054 63.0-64.5] SFX: Muffled scuffle, rustle of heavy silk and frantic gasps echoing off cathedral stone.
[L055 64.5-66.0] SCREEN: High wide shot down the vaulted cathedral aisle showing the entire congregation watching in stunned silence as the guards drag Juliana.
[L056 66.0-68.1] SCREEN: Wide eye-level shot looking down the petal-strewn marble aisle. A tall, rugged man in a worn dark trench coat—The Bearded Stranger—emerges into the center of the nave.
[L057 66.0-68.1] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger steps deliberately into the aisle, his heavy boots echoing.
[L058 68.1-70.5] SCREEN: Close-up on the Noble Matriarch freezing in utter shock and outrage.
[L059 69.9-72.1] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Low, Thunderous, Imposing): "Take your hands off her."
[L060 70.5-72.8] SCREEN: Medium tracking shot front-on as The Bearded Stranger marches down the flower-strewn aisle with resolute purpose.
[L061 72.8-75.1] SCREEN: Medium shot on the Noble Matriarch stepping forward on the altar steps, furiously pointing a finger at him.
[L062 73.0-76.8] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Indignant, Screeching): "And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!"
[L063 75.1-77.0] SCREEN: High wide shot of the magnificent vaulted hall as The Bearded Stranger walks steadily forward, dwarfing the aisle.
[L064 77.0-79.0] SCREEN: Medium shot on the lead royal guard squaring his shoulders, barring the stranger's advance while Juliana stands behind him.
[L065 77.2-78.9] ROYAL GUARD (Aggressive, Threatening): "Stand aside, stranger!"
[L066 79.0-81.0] SCREEN: Medium close-up profile on The Bearded Stranger, eyes burning with quiet, lethal resolve.
[L067 79.3-80.9] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Deadly): "I said..."
[L068 81.0-84.0] SCREEN: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's intense, scarred face.
[L069 81.8-83.9] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Dangerous, Uncompromising): "...let her go."
[L070 84.0-85.5] SCREEN: Medium action shot as the guard charges toward The Bearded Stranger.
[L071 84.0-85.5] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger effortlessly blocks the guard's strike and drives a devastating strike into him, dropping the armed guard instantly to the floor.
[L072 84.5-85.4] SFX: A heavy, bone-rattling punch followed by the clatter and thud of the guard collapsing onto the stone floor.
[L073 85.5-88.1] SCREEN: Medium close-up of Gerald turning frantically to the remaining guards and congregation, panicking.
[L074 85.6-88.0] THE FORMER GROOM (Frantic, Shouting): "What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!"
[L075 88.1-89.3] SCREEN: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger standing unmoved over the fallen guard, turning his gaze toward Juliana.
[L076 89.3-91.7] SCREEN: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger stepping up to Lady Juliana, who gazes up at him in stunned breathlessness.
[L077 90.4-91.6] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Gentle, Protective): "Are you hurt?"
[L078 91.7-94.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's tear-streaked face as she shakes her head gently, overwhelmed with wonder.
[L079 91.8-93.6] ACTION: Juliana softly shakes her head 'no', her wide blue eyes locked onto him.
[L080 94.0-96.5] SCREEN: Close-up profile of The Bearded Stranger casting a sharp, menacing glance toward the other guard.
[L081 94.1-96.3] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Firm, Menacing): "Good. Then don't touch her again."
[L082 96.5-98.4] SCREEN: Medium close-up on the Noble Matriarch shrieking in exasperation from the altar steps.
[L083 96.5-98.5] NOBLE MATRIARCH (Furious, Hysterical): "You cannot interfere in a family matter!"
[L084 98.4-100.8] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana's elderly father looking down, gripping his hands nervously with profound guilt.
[L085 98.8-100.8] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Deep, Resonant): "I can..."
[L086 100.8-103.0] SCREEN: Medium shot of guests in the pews whispering and reacting in hushed shock.
[L087 100.8-103.8] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Stern, Accusing): "...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church."
[L088 103.0-105.9] SCREEN: Two-shot profile of The Bearded Stranger and Lady Juliana framed against the illuminated stained-glass rose window.
[L089 104.2-107.4] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Gentle): "You shouldn't have to beg anybody..."
[L090 105.9-108.8] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana looking up into his eyes, moved to the core.
[L091 107.4-109.0] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Affirming, Sincere): "...to remember your worth."
[L092 108.8-110.8] SCREEN: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's rugged, bearded face looking down at her with tender reverence.
[L093 110.8-112.5] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana, her lips parting in quiet astonishment.
[L094 110.9-112.5] LADY JULIANA (Whispering, Bewildered): "Why are you doing this?"
[L095 112.5-114.2] SCREEN: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger, completely unfazed.
[L096 112.8-114.1] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Simple, Certain): "Because I want to."
[L097 114.2-116.0] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana's father wringing his gold ring, eyes heavy with regret.
[L098 116.0-117.9] SCREEN: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger slipping his hand into his coat pocket.
[L099 117.9-119.2] SCREEN: Close-up of Juliana watching him with rapt, trembling anticipation.
[L100 119.2-121.0] SCREEN: Extreme close-up of The Bearded Stranger's rugged fingers holding up a simple, polished silver band.
[L101 119.8-122.1] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Honorable, Earnest): "You came here to become a wife."
[L102 121.0-123.2] SCREEN: Medium shot on The Bearded Stranger extending the ring toward Juliana.
[L103 122.5-124.2] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Resolute): "They took that from you."
[L104 123.2-125.1] SCREEN: Over-the-shoulder medium shot past The Bearded Stranger onto Gerald standing petrified and humiliated in the aisle.
[L105 125.1-127.4] SCREEN: Medium close-up on The Bearded Stranger presenting the ring directly to Juliana.
[L106 125.3-127.3] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Earnest, Sincere): "I am offering it back."
[L107 127.4-130.2] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana glancing down at the ring, breathless and overwhelmed.
[L108 127.7-129.9] LADY JULIANA (Soft, Hesitant): "You don't even know me."
[L109 130.2-132.7] SCREEN: Close-up on The Bearded Stranger's warm, piercing gaze.
[L110 130.4-132.0] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Quiet, Steady): "I know enough."
[L111 132.7-135.5] SCREEN: Full wide profile shot as The Bearded Stranger slowly and respectfully drops onto one knee before Lady Juliana.
[L112 133.2-135.5] ACTION: The Bearded Stranger sinks to one knee on the cathedral aisle, offering the silver ring up to Juliana.
[L113 134.8-136.2] SFX: A collective, stunned gasp rippling across the entire congregation.
[L114 135.5-137.3] SCREEN: Medium shot of the Noble Matriarch, Gerald, and the Lady in Gold Gown frozen in sheer, jaw-dropped bewilderment.
[L115 137.3-140.5] SCREEN: Low-angle medium close-up of The Bearded Stranger on his knee, holding the silver ring high with steady dignity.
[L116 137.5-140.3] THE BEARDED STRANGER (Solemn, Devoted): "Lady Juliana... accept my hand."
[L117 140.5-145.8] SCREEN: Close-up on Juliana looking down at him, fresh tears trailing down her flushed cheeks as a soft, trembling smile of hope touches her lips into a slow fade.
[L118 140.5-145.8] ACTION: Juliana gazes down at her rugged savior, overcome with emotion as the swelling score holds on the cliffhanger.

Task: find the best promo candidates in THIS episode. Return 1 to 3 candidates, best first. Fewer is fine when the episode has only one strong moment; never return two candidates that are nearly the same cut.

Return this JSON object:
{
  "episode_summary": "<= 45 words: what happens in this episode, with character names and roles, for story memory",
  "candidates": [
    {
      "title": "3-6 word editor label",
      "segments": [{"start_line": "L0xx", "end_line": "L0yy"}],
      "hook_line": "L0xx",
      "hook": "what the viewer sees/hears in the first 3 seconds and why it stops the scroll",
      "hook_quote": "exact words from hook_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "cliffhanger_line": "L0yy",
      "cliffhanger": "the unresolved question the viewer is left with at the cut",
      "cliffhanger_quote": "exact words from cliffhanger_line, or \"\" if visual",
      "why_it_works": "one sentence",
      "setup_needed": "what a brand-new viewer must already know to follow it, or \"none\"",
      "spoiler_risk": "low | medium | high (does it give away a major twist of the series?)",
      "self_score": 1-10
    }
  ]
}
